PLATE_ECONOMY: Each parent has its own stripped plate because the artifact differs. All 16 are DERIVE_FAMILY_PLATE inside five desks. No plate is reused as an identical file. No plate is a new unrelated room.
COPY_SOURCE: src/projects/jurnl/runtime/screens/SetupScreens.tsx and src/projects/jurnl/data/f02/screens.ts. Account notification and Ask Jurnl strings from AccountScreens. Image lettering is guidance. Source truth stays canonical.

PARENTS.COMPOSITION_THESIS: PRIVATE CONTEXT DOSSIER. The folder is open only partway. Slips fan out. No robot, no sparkles.
